name: Salamander Grand (measured)
author: Alexander Holm (recordings), Resonance analyzer (measurement)
license: Recordings: CC BY 3.0, Alexander Holm, Salamander Grand Piano V3
source: Yamaha C5, two AKG C414 in AB ~12 cm above the strings, 44.1 kHz 16-bit release; sampled in minor thirds, 16 velocity layers

decay_model.note: per-partial decays shrunk toward this law by regularize() + decay outliers pulled to within x1.65 of neighbours (regularize_decays.py) + brightness outliers pulled to within 1.5 dB-equivalent of neighbours (regularize_brightness.py) + per-layer envelope fit to the recordings (tools/calibrate_envelope.py) + levels trimmed to the recordings (tools/calibrate_levels.py, 0.15 s window)
